sentences.ko: 결혼 생활 유지하는 게 얼마나 힘든 건지 넌 몰라.
sentences.text: You have no idea what it takes to make a marriage work.

alts.text: Marriage is hard work, you've got no clue.
Making a marriage work requires more than you could possibly imagine.

sentences.note: **what it takes**는 '그걸 해내려면 뭐가 드는지'라는 뜻으로, 남이 쉽게 말할 때 '해 보지도 않고'라는 느낌으로 받아칠 때 씁니다. **make a marriage work**처럼 **make ~ work**는 관계나 계획을 '굴러가게 만들다'라는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 내가 뭐라도 해 줄 수 있으면 좋겠는데.
sentences.text: I wish there was something I can do.

alts.text: Wish I could help somehow.
If only there were something I could do to help.

sentences.note: 힘든 일을 겪는 사람에게 위로할 때 쓰는 말입니다. 문법책대로라면 could지만 말할 때는 **I wish there was something I can do**처럼 섞여 나옵니다. 짧게는 **Wish I could help**라고 합니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 뭐, 기왕 하는 거면 계속 하는 게 낫겠다.
sentences.text: Well, if I'm going to do this, I better keep going.

alts.text: Might as well keep at it.
Since I have started this, I had better continue.

sentences.note: **I better**는 I'd better에서 'd가 빠진 구어로, '~하는 게 낫겠다'고 스스로 다짐할 때 씁니다. 이미 시작한 걸 멈추지 않겠다는 자리에서는 **keep going**이나 **Might as well keep at it**을 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 아니 뭐, 그 사람들은 그거 말고도 신경 쓸 게 많잖아.
sentences.text: I mean, they have more important things to worry about.

alts.text: They've got bigger fish to fry.
Surely they have more pressing matters to attend to.

sentences.note: '그 사람들은 그런 거 신경 쓸 여유 없어'라고 상대를 안심시킬 때 **more important things to worry about**을 씁니다. 같은 뜻의 관용구로 **bigger fish to fry**가 있습니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.text: Hey, I'm getting a little tired of this.

alts.text: Ugh, I'm so over this.
To be honest, I am beginning to grow tired of this.

sentences.note: **getting a little tired of**는 '슬슬 질린다, 짜증 난다'를 부드럽게 돌려 말하는 표현입니다. 완전히 질렸을 때는 **so over this**라고 합니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 알았어, 나 이거 5년째 쓰고 있거든. 어떻게 쓰는 건지 알아.
sentences.text: Okay, I've had it for 5 years and I know how it works.

alts.text: Relax, I've owned it five years. I know what I'm doing.
I have owned it for five years, so I understand how it works.

sentences.note: 남이 자꾸 쓰는 법을 가르치려 들 때 **I've had it for 5 years** 로 '오래 써 봤다'를 말해요. 가진 기간은 have 의 현재완료로 말하고, **I know how it works** 는 '어떻게 돌아가는지 안다'는 뜻으로 물건에도 제도에도 써요.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.text: Well, you you you don't want to give into the fear.

alts.text: Come on, don't let the fear win.
You should not allow yourself to give in to fear.

sentences.note: **give into the fear** 는 두려움에 굴복한다는 말로, 망설이는 친구를 다독일 때 써요. **you don't want to** 는 '~하고 싶지 않다'가 아니라 '~하면 안 좋아'라는 부드러운 충고예요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 첫 월급 받던 날이 아직도 기억나.
sentences.text: I remember the day I got my first paycheck.

alts.text: Man, my first paycheck — I still remember that day.
I still recall the day I received my first salary.

sentences.note: **first paycheck** 는 '첫 월급'을 말할 때 가장 흔히 쓰는 말이에요. **I remember the day** 뒤에 문장을 바로 붙이면 '~하던 날이 기억나'가 돼서 옛날 얘기를 꺼낼 때 좋아요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.ko: 자, 여러분, 자리 좀 만들게 비켜 주세요.
sentences.text: Come on people, please let me make some room.

alts.text: Scoot over, guys, I need some space.
Excuse me, everyone, could you please allow me to clear some space?

sentences.note: **make some room** 은 사람이나 물건을 치워서 자리를 만드는 거예요. 붐비는 데서 친구들한테 **Come on people** 하고 말을 꺼내면 '자, 다들'처럼 들려요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 난 이제 털고 갈 거야. 너도 나랑 같이 털고 가는 거야.
sentences.text: I'm moving on and you're moving on with me.

alts.text: I'm done dwelling on it, and so are you.
I am putting this behind me, and I would like you to do the same with me.

sentences.note: **moving on** 은 지난 일(이별, 실패)을 털고 다음으로 간다는 뜻이에요. 같이 힘든 일을 겪은 친구한테 이제 그만 잊자고 할 때 써요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends
